title: 第二百三十一章 神念叩心草暖道伤第二百三十章 袖里融灵甜破忘情
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡骨镇天正文第二百三十一章神念叩心·草暖道伤（..la）神帝出关的动静，是把整个神域的云都压低了三寸。
没有仙乐，没有霞光，只有一股子万古玄冰般的威压，顺着神帝宫的九龙柱往下滑，连殿外的仙禽都噤了声，缩在巢里瑟瑟发抖。烈阳神将跪在殿外，额头抵着冰冷的玉砖，后背的九轮法相都暗了三分，才敢出声禀报：“陛下，公主殿下炼化异宝，引动天地异象，老臣已查过，似无魔气……”
“异宝？”
殿内传来一声淡得没有起伏的声音，像冰棱撞在玄铁上。神帝坐在九龙玉椅上，周身没有半点灵气波动——太上忘情道修到极致，早已返璞归真，连呼吸都和天地同频，可他眉心那道淡金色的道纹，却微微跳动着，像被什么烫到了似的。
他梦了三万年的草叶，歪歪扭扭，带着凡俗的暖意，今日出关的瞬间，竟清晰地闻到了一丝甜香，不是神域琼浆的冷香，是带着铁锈、血气和烟火气的甜，和他梦里的味道分毫不差。
“呈上来。”
神帝指尖在扶手上轻轻叩了一下，整座神帝宫的灵气都跟着颤了颤。
云清瑶站在殿中央，流云袖垂得笔直，仙衣下摆的草叶印被她用灵气遮得严严实实，怀里的玉佩贴着那半块糖糕，甜香被玉佩的隔绝阵法压得只剩一丝，却还是像根细针，扎得她心口发闷。她面上依旧淡漠，声音稳得像冰湖：“回父帝，是女儿偶然所得的一块顽石，内蕴一丝异火，炼化时引动了灵气躁动，并无他异。”
“顽石？”
神帝抬眼，眸子里没有瞳孔，只有一片混沌的星海，神念顺着视线扫过云清瑶的全身。这神念没有杀气，却比任何神兵都锋利，能剖开仙骨，照见神魂。云清瑶只觉心口一疼，那是太上忘情道压了近万年的道伤——当年她强行斩断对凡俗的念想，把一丝凡气硬生生从神魂里抽出来，伤了心脉，平日靠灵气温养才能压制，今日被神念一扫，那淤积的伤处瞬间翻涌起来。
她闷哼一声，嘴角渗出一丝淡金色的神血，却依旧绷着身子，不肯退后半步。神念扫过她下摆的草叶印，又扫过冰殿的方向，那里那道被陈默劈出的暖痕，正顺着玄冰慢慢蔓延，把周围的灵气都暖得泛着涟漪。神帝的眉心道纹跳得更厉害了，他梦里的那株歪草，就是这般模样，带着能烧穿万古玄冰的热意。
“顽石的火，能烧得动朕的神域玄冰？”
神帝的声音冷了一分，神念又要往深了探，目标直指云清瑶怀里的玉佩。云清瑶心里一紧，下意识往前踏了半步，刚好挡住了神念的去路。这一挡，神念撞在她的心脉道伤上，疼得她浑身一颤，淡金色的神血顺着下巴滴在玉砖上，烫出了个小小的坑。
“女儿炼化时心急，动了旧伤，并无大碍。”她咬着牙，声音里终于带了一丝极淡的颤音，“那顽石已被女儿碾碎，残渣也处理了，父帝不必挂心。”
神帝盯着她看了三息，那混沌的眸子里闪过一丝极淡的狐疑。他今日出关，卦象显示“灭世草叶生于至亲”，原本以为是云清瑶修行出了岔子，可眼下她的神魂里除了太上忘情的道韵，并无其他异样。那丝甜香和暖意，倒像是她道伤发作时溢出来的血气，混着炼化异宝的余韵。
“罢了。”神帝收回神念，指尖一弹，一枚温养道伤的九转还心丹落在云清瑶手里，“近期不要出宫，朕要亲自推演那‘灭世草叶’的方位。若再引动异象，提头来见。”
“女儿遵旨。”
云清瑶躬身行礼，指尖捏着那枚还心丹，却觉得它冷得像块冰，远不如怀里糖糕的热乎气来得实在。她退出大殿时，后背的仙衣已经被冷汗浸透了，烈阳神将想上前搀扶，却被她抬手制止，只留下一句“看好宫门，任何人不得打扰”，便匆匆回了冰殿。
……
冰殿里，那道暖痕已经蔓延了半面墙。

陈默蹲在玄冰上，旧柴刀插在冰缝里，正用劈柴的发力，一下一下地往冰缝里夯。他听见了外面的动静，知道那仙女在帮他挡着，虽然不知道她是谁，但他恩怨分明——人家帮了他，他就不能白受着。他没本事冲出去打架，就用自己会的法子，把周围的灵气往暖痕这边引，凡血顺着刀柄滴在冰缝里，滋啦滋啦冒着热气，把玄冰融得更深。
“这破灵气，比总规的银网还冷，不过老子有热乎的……”他嘟囔着，从怀里摸出一点之前掉在袖里的糖糕渣，混着凡血，捏了个只有指甲盖大的迷你草叶，歪歪扭扭的，和刀身上的纹路一模一样。他听见云清瑶进来的脚步声，随手把那迷你草叶塞进了她放在冰殿角落的玉佩旁边——那玉佩他刚才摸过，冷得扎手，他想说不定这小玩意儿能给那仙女暖暖。
云清瑶走进殿时，正看见陈默蹲在冰缝边，后背的伤口还在渗血，却咧着嘴笑，露出沾着血沫的牙。她刚要开口，就觉怀里玉佩一热，那枚迷你草叶正贴着玉佩的内壁，凡血的暖意混着糖渣的甜香，透过玉佩的隔绝阵法，丝丝缕缕地钻进她的心脉。
那淤积了近万年的道伤，像被温水泡开的冻疮，传来一阵酥酥麻麻的痒意，疼了上万年的地方，第一次有了松动的迹象。她愣在原地，指尖不自觉地按在玉佩上，隔着冰冷的玉质，能清晰地感觉到那点微小的、却烫人的暖。
“你……”她开口，声音却哑得不像话，连自己都吓了一跳。
陈默抬头，抹了一把脸上的血，把柴刀往冰上一杵，暖橙色的刀气顺着冰缝窜出去三尺：“谢了啊，刚才外面那老家伙是你爹吧？没难为你吧？我这人不会说漂亮话，就会劈柴刻草叶，你要是冷，我再多劈两道缝，这灵气暖了就不冻了。”
他说着，又抡起柴刀，往另一块玄冰上劈去。刀身上的歪草叶纹亮得惊人，劈出的暖痕和之前的那道连在了一起，把整面冰墙都映得泛着橙色的光。云清瑶看着他的动作，看着他刀身上那歪歪扭扭的纹路，看着他怀里露出来的半块干硬糖糕，忽然觉得眼眶发烫——不是神魂受伤的疼，是一种陌生的、热乎的酸胀感，像她小时候偷偷尝过的凡间糖糕，甜得发颤。
她没有运转功法压制这股情绪，也没有念叨“太上忘情”，只是静静地站在那里，看着陈默劈柴，看着暖痕蔓延，看着怀里玉佩的温度越来越高。她忽然想起父帝梦里的那株草叶，原来不是灭世，是暖世。
而此刻的神帝宫内，神帝正对着推演出的卦象皱眉。卦象显示，灭世草叶的方位，正指向他最疼爱的女儿寝宫，卦辞只有四个字：
至亲藏暖。
他指尖捻着那枚用来推演的草叶符，符纸无端地烫了一下，像被什么凡俗的东西灼到了似的。他抬头望向云清瑶寝宫的方向，混沌的眸子里第一次泛起一丝极淡的困惑——那丫头怀里的，到底是什么“顽石”？
冰殿里，云清瑶终于动了。她走到陈默身边，素白的手指轻轻碰了碰那道暖痕，冰冷的指尖被烫得缩了一下，却还是贴了上去。暖流顺着指尖钻进经脉，那道顽固的道伤，又松动了一分。
“你这草叶，”她轻声开口，声音里没有了平日的清冷，带着一丝极淡的、连她自己都没察觉的暖意，“刻得真歪。”
陈默咧嘴笑了，血沫子顺着嘴角往下淌：“歪才对，刻直了就没魂了。王婆蒸糖糕还得故意歪一点，说那样才甜。”
云清瑶没说话，只是把怀里的糖糕掏出来一小块，递到他嘴边。糖糕还是干硬的，却带着她的体温，暖得发烫。陈默愣了一下，张嘴咬了一大口，甜得直眯眼，连嘴角的血沫子都忘了擦。
冰殿外的玄冰，还在被暖痕一点点融化，露出底下紫色的灵土。而神域万载不变的寒冷里，第一次混进了一丝糖糕的甜香，像一颗种子，正悄悄发芽。..la

Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 231 of the main text of Mortal Bones Controlling the Sky: Divine Mind Knocking on the Heart·Cao Nuan Dao Shang (..la) The sound of the God Emperor leaving seclusion lowered the clouds in the entire God's Domain by three inches.
There was no fairy music, no glow, only a coercion like eternal black ice, sliding down the Nine Dragon Pillars of the Divine Emperor's Palace. Even the fairy birds outside the palace were silent and huddled in their nests, shivering. General Lieyang knelt outside the palace, his forehead pressed against the cold jade brick, and the nine-wheeled dharma image on his back dimmed by three points before he dared to report: "Your Majesty, Your Majesty, the princess has refined the rare treasure and triggered the vision of heaven and earth. I have checked it, and it seems that there is no evil spirit..."
"Exotic treasure?"
There was a sound that was so faint that there was no fluctuation in the hall, like ice hitting black iron. The God Emperor was sitting on the Nine Dragon Jade Chair, with no spiritual energy fluctuations around his body - Taishang Wangqing Taoism had been cultivated to the extreme, and he had long since returned to his original nature. Even his breathing was at the same frequency as heaven and earth, but the pale golden Taoist pattern between his eyebrows was beating slightly, as if he had been burned by something.
He had dreamed of blades of grass for 30,000 years, twisting and turning, with earthly warmth. The moment he came out of seclusion today, he could clearly smell a hint of sweet fragrance. It was not the cold fragrance of divine nectar, but the sweetness of rust, blood and fireworks. It was exactly the same as the smell in his dream.
"Send it up."
The God Emperor's fingertips tapped lightly on the armrest, and the aura of the entire God Emperor's Palace trembled.
Yun Qingyao stood in the center of the hall, her Liuyun sleeves hanging straight, and the grass leaf marks on the hem of her fairy clothes were tightly covered by her spiritual energy. The jade pendant in her arms was pressed against the half piece of candy cake. The sweet fragrance was suppressed by the isolation formation of the jade pendant, but it was still like a thin needle, piercing her heart and feeling stuffy. Her face was still indifferent, and her voice was as steady as an icy lake: "Hui Emperor, it is a stubborn stone that my daughter got by chance. It contains a trace of strange fire. It caused agitation in the spiritual energy during refining. There is no other difference."
"Stubborn stone?"
The God Emperor raised his eyes. There were no pupils in his eyes, only a chaotic sea of stars. His divine thoughts followed his sight and swept across Yun Qingyao's body. This divine thought has no murderous intent, but is sharper than any divine weapon. It can cut open the bones of immortals and reveal the soul. Yun Qingyao only felt a pain in her heart. It was a Taoist injury that Taishang Wangqingdao had suppressed for nearly ten thousand years. Back then, she forcibly cut off her thoughts about the world and pulled out a trace of the worldly energy from her soul, hurting her heart. Normally, she could only suppress it with the nourishment of her spiritual energy. Today, it was swept away by her divine thoughts, and the stagnant wound instantly surged.
She groaned, and a trace of light golden divine blood oozed from the corner of her mouth, but she still tensed up and refused to take a step back. His spiritual thoughts swept across the grass blade mark at her hem, and then in the direction of the ice palace. The warm mark there that was cut by Chen Mo was slowly spreading along the black ice, making the surrounding spiritual energy ripple with warmth. The lines between the God Emperor's brows jumped even more violently. The crooked grass in his dream looked like this, with a heat that could burn through the eternal ice.
"Can the fire of the stubborn stone burn my divine ice?"
The God Emperor's voice became colder, and his spiritual thoughts were about to probe deeper again, aiming directly at the jade pendant in Yun Qingyao's arms. Yun Qingyao's heart tightened, and she subconsciously took half a step forward, just blocking the way of the spiritual thought. At this time, the divine thought hit her heart and pulse, causing her whole body to tremble in pain. The pale golden divine blood dripped down her chin and onto the jade brick, creating a small pit.
"My daughter was anxious when she was refining, and she injured an old injury, but it's not serious." She gritted her teeth, and finally there was a faint tremor in her voice. "The stubborn stone has been crushed by my daughter, and the residue has been dealt with. Father, don't worry."
The God Emperor stared at her for three breaths, a faint suspicion flashing in his chaotic eyes. He came out of seclusion today, and the hexagram showed that "leaves of world-destroying grass are born from close relatives." I originally thought that there was something wrong with Yun Qingyao's practice, but now there is nothing strange in her soul except the Taoist rhyme of the Supreme Being. The sweet fragrance and warmth seemed like the blood that overflowed when she was injured, mixed with the aftertaste of refining rare treasures.
"That's all." The God Emperor withdrew his thoughts and said,With a flick of his fingertips, a Nine-turn Heart-Returning Pill that warms and nourishes Taoist injuries fell into Yun Qingyao's hand. "Don't leave the palace in the near future. I want to personally deduce the location of the 'World-Destroying Grass Blade'. If it causes another strange phenomenon, please come and see me."
"My daughter obeys the decree."
Yun Qingyao bowed and saluted, holding the Heart-Returning Pill between her fingertips, but she felt that it was as cold as ice, far less solid than the warmth of the candy cake in her arms. When she exited the main hall, the fairy clothes on her back were soaked with cold sweat. Lieyang God General wanted to step forward to help him, but she raised her hand to stop him. She only said "Watch the palace gate, no one is allowed to disturb" and hurried back to the Ice Palace.
…
In the ice palace, the trace of warmth had spread to half of the wall.
Chen Mo was squatting on the black ice, with an old hatchet stuck in the crevice in the ice. He was using the force of chopping firewood to pound it into the crevice one by one. He heard the noise outside and knew that the fairy was protecting him. Although he didn't know who she was, he had a clear grudge - someone helped him, so he couldn't suffer in vain. He didn't have the ability to rush out and fight, so he used his own method to draw the surrounding spiritual energy towards Nuanhen. The mortal blood dripped down the handle of the knife into the cracks in the ice, and steamed up, melting the black ice deeper.
"This broken spiritual energy is colder than the general silver net, but I have something warm..." He muttered, taking out some sugar cake crumbs that had fallen into his sleeve, mixed with mortal blood, and pinched a mini blade of grass that was only as big as a fingernail. It was crooked and exactly the same as the lines on the blade. He heard Yun Qingyao's footsteps coming in, and casually stuffed the mini blade of grass next to the jade pendant she placed in the corner of the ice palace - he had touched the jade pendant just now, and it was so cold that it pricked his hands. He thought that maybe this little gadget could keep the fairy warm.
When Yun Qingyao walked into the hall, she saw Chen Mo squatting beside the ice crack. The wound on his back was still bleeding, but he was grinning, showing his teeth stained with blood. Just as she was about to speak, she felt the jade pendant in her arms became warm. The mini blade of grass was pressing against the inner wall of the jade pendant. The warmth of mortal blood mixed with the sweet fragrance of sugar residue penetrated into her heart through the isolation formation of the jade pendant.
The wound that had been accumulated for nearly ten thousand years was like frostbite soaked in warm water. There was a numb and itchy feeling. For the first time, the place that had been hurting for tens of thousands of years showed signs of loosening. She froze in place, her fingertips unconsciously pressing on the jade pendant. Through the cold jade, she could clearly feel the tiny but scalding warmth.
"You..." She spoke, but her voice was so hoarse that she even started to frighten herself.
Chen Mo raised his head, wiped the blood from his face, and thrust the hatchet into the ice. Warm orange sword energy shot out three feet along the cracks in the ice: "Thank you. That old guy outside just now is your father, right? I'm not embarrassing you, right? I don't know how to talk nicely, and I can chop wood and carve grass leaves. If you're cold, I'll chop two more cracks. The aura will warm you up and you won't freeze."
As he spoke, he picked up the hatchet again and struck another piece of black ice. The crooked grass blade pattern on the blade was astonishingly bright, and the warm mark it made was connected with the previous one, making the entire ice wall glow with orange light. Yun Qingyao looked at his movements, at the crooked lines on his blade, and at the half piece of dry hard candy cake exposed in his arms, and suddenly felt her eyes burning - not the pain of a wounded soul, but a strange, warm soreness, like the earthly candy cake she had secretly tasted when she was a child, so sweet that it made her tremble.
She didn't run her skills to suppress this emotion, nor did she say "Too Supreme Forgetting Love", she just stood there quietly, watching Chen Mo chop wood, watching the warmth marks spread, and watching the temperature of the jade pendant in her arms getting higher and higher. She suddenly remembered the blade of grass in her father's dream. It turned out that it was not the destruction of the world, but the warmth of the world.
At this moment, in the Palace of the God Emperor, the God Emperor was frowning at the hexagrams that had been deduced. The hexagram shows that the direction of the blade of the World-Destroying Grass is pointing towards the palace of his beloved daughter. The hexagram contains only four words:
Close relatives hide warmth.
He twisted the blade of grass talisman used for deduction with his fingertips. The talisman was burned for no reason, as if it had been burned by something.It's like something mundane is burning. He looked up in the direction of Yun Qingyao's bedroom, and for the first time there was a hint of confusion in his chaotic eyes - what kind of "hard rock" was in that girl's arms?
In the ice palace, Yun Qingyao finally moved. She walked to Chen Mo and lightly touched the warm mark with her plain white fingers. Her cold fingertips shrank due to the heat, but she still pressed against it. The warm current penetrated into the meridians along the fingertips, and the stubborn wounds loosened a little more.
"You blade of grass," she said softly, the usual coldness in her voice was gone, and there was a hint of warmth that she didn't even notice, "the carving is really crooked."
Chen Mo grinned, blood dripping down the corners of his mouth: "It's right when it's crooked, but if it's straight it'll be soulless. Grandma Wang had to deliberately steam the sugar cake a little crooked, saying that it would be sweeter."
Yun Qingyao said nothing, but took out a small piece of candy cake from her arms and handed it to his mouth. The candy cake was still dry and hard, but it was warm with her body temperature. Chen Mo was stunned for a moment, then opened his mouth and took a big bite. It was so sweet that he squinted his eyes and even forgot to wipe the blood foam from the corner of his mouth.
The black ice outside the Ice Palace is still melting little by little with traces of warmth, revealing the purple spiritual soil underneath. And for the first time in the coldness that has remained unchanged in the Divine Realm, there is a hint of the sweet fragrance of candy cake, like a seed, quietly sprouting. ..la
